newsitem.title: UK: Dixons extends gain, upgrades in view.
newsitem.headline: Dixons extends gain, upgrades in view.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc built on early results-led gains on Wednesday with the market expecting profit forecast upgrades to follow the analysts' meeting, market-makers said.
Dixons traded 33p, or 6.7 percent, higher at 525-1/2p pushing ahead shares in retailer Kingfisher which owns electrical stores chain Comet. Kingfisher rose 24p to 688-1/2p.
"We're expecting ugrades but we haven't heard from the analysts yet. The meeting only started at ten o'clock (0900 GMT)," said one market-maker.
